name: mindmesh-monorepo
description: MindMesh monorepo for Next.js web application and FastAPI backend.

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "web,api" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:legacy: npx concurrently -n "web,api" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.install:all: npm run install:web && npm run install:api
